title: D2P Identifiers
description: Identifier and small scalar definitions shared by all D2P schemas: global IDs (one definition per prefix), element IDs, qualified names, versions, timestamps, idempotency keys, diagnostic codes, versioned IDs, software info, actors and evaluator descriptors. The root accepts any global ID.

globalId.title: Global ID
globalId.description: Identifier of a document or artifact: '<prefix>_<opaque>' with one of the registered prefixes. Consumers treat the opaque part as opaque and compare IDs byte-wise. Producers SHOULD use a UUIDv7 or ULID as the opaque part; fixtures use readable slugs.

revisionId.title: Artifact revision ID
revisionId.description: Global ID of an artifact revision (prefix 'rev_').

evaluationRequestId.title: Evaluation request ID
evaluationRequestId.description: Global ID of an evaluation request (prefix 'erq_').

snapshotId.title: Geometry snapshot ID
snapshotId.description: Global ID of a geometry snapshot (prefix 'snp_').

fitEvaluationReportId.title: Fit evaluation report ID
fitEvaluationReportId.description: Global ID of a fit evaluation report (prefix 'fer_').

validationReportId.title: Validation report ID
validationReportId.description: Global ID of a validation report (prefix 'vrp_').

gateEvaluationId.title: Gate evaluation ID
gateEvaluationId.description: Global ID of a gate evaluation (prefix 'gte_').

sceneId.title: Export scene ID
sceneId.description: Global ID of an export scene (prefix 'xsc_').

printJobId.title: Print job ID
printJobId.description: Global ID of a print job (prefix 'pjs_').

testRunReportId.title: Test run report ID
testRunReportId.description: Global ID of a test run report (prefix 'trr_').

benchmarkRunId.title: Benchmark run ID
benchmarkRunId.description: Global ID of a benchmark run (prefix 'bmr_').

evidenceBundleId.title: Quality evidence bundle ID
evidenceBundleId.description: Global ID of a quality evidence bundle (prefix 'qeb_').

evaluationId.title: Pattern evaluation ID
evaluationId.description: Global ID of a pattern evaluation (prefix 'pev_').

sceneInputId.title: Scene input ID
sceneInputId.description: Global ID of a 3D scene input (prefix 'sci_').

sceneSnapshotId.title: Scene snapshot ID
sceneSnapshotId.description: Global ID of a 3D scene snapshot (prefix 'ssn_').

meshResultId.title: Panel mesh result ID
meshResultId.description: Global ID of a panel mesh result (prefix 'pmr_').

simReportId.title: Simulation report ID
simReportId.description: Global ID of a 3D simulation report (prefix 'smr_').

proposalId.title: Pattern proposal ID
proposalId.description: Global ID of a pattern proposal (prefix 'ppr_').

inspectionId.title: 3D edit inspection ID
inspectionId.description: Global ID of a 3D edit inspection result (prefix 'ier_').

sceneExpectationId.title: Scene expectation ID
sceneExpectationId.description: Global ID of a 3D scene expectation (prefix 'sxp_').

elementId.title: Element ID
elementId.description: Stable identifier of an entity inside one aggregate or document (piece, edge, feature, seam interface, size entry, layer, ...). All 'id' members of one document share one namespace and are unique. An element ID is kept across revisions while the element exists, is never reused for a different element of the same artifact lineage, and MUST NOT be derived from coordinates, array positions, SVG/PDF object IDs, mesh indices or evaluation order. Keys ('key', 'sizeKey', 'cutInstanceKey', 'configurationKey') use the same format.

extensionNamespace.title: Extension namespace
extensionNamespace.description: Reverse-DNS namespace of an extension. Contains at least one dot, so the reserved namespace 'd2p' cannot be expressed.

d2pName.title: D2P qualified name
d2pName.description: Qualified name in the namespace 'd2p', which is reserved for this standard. The local part starts with a letter. An unknown 'd2p:' term is always a structural error.

extensionName.title: Extension qualified name
extensionName.description: Qualified name in an extension namespace ('<extensionNamespace>:<local>'). The local part starts with a letter. Unknown extension terms are handled by the extension rules of the standard.

qualifiedName.title: Qualified name
qualifiedName.description: Name of an extensible vocabulary term (feature type, rule ID, profile ID, event type, ...): a d2pName or an extensionName, at most 128 characters.

semver.title: Semantic version
semver.description: Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 version without build metadata (pre-release identifiers are allowed).

schemaVersion.title: Schema version
schemaVersion.description: Full SemVer of the standard release a document was written against. Documents of this release use '1.0.0'. Compatibility is checked before schema validation (D2P-STR-003).

timestamp.title: Timestamp
timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date-time in UTC ('Z' suffix only, optional fraction of up to 9 digits). Every member holding a timestamp ends in 'At'.

idempotencyKey.title: Idempotency key
idempotencyKey.description: Client-chosen key that makes a command retry-safe: 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters without spaces.

diagnosticCode.title: Diagnostic code
diagnosticCode.description: Code of a diagnostic: a standard code 'D2P-<STR|REF|SEM|EVL>-<nnn>' from the diagnostic code registry, or an extension code '<extensionNamespace>:<UPPER-CASE-NAME>'.

versionedId.title: Versioned ID
versionedId.description: Identifier of an independently versioned vocabulary, profile or suite: a qualified name plus its SemVer version.

id.description: Qualified name of the versioned item.

softwareInfo.title: Software info
softwareInfo.description: Name and version of a piece of software (implementation, generator, runner).

version.description: Software version as published by its maintainers (not necessarily SemVer).

actor.title: Actor
actor.description: Principal that performed an action. Names, e-mail addresses and other personal data never appear in actor objects.

kind.description: Kind of principal: a person, an (AI or automation) agent, or the system itself.

evaluatorDescriptor.title: Evaluator descriptor
evaluatorDescriptor.description: Identifies the implementation and profile that produced a derived result (pattern evaluation, geometry snapshot, fit evaluation report, validation report). 'precision' is mandatory for evaluator implementations and may be omitted only in analytically computed fixture files.

engineVersion.description: Version string of the evaluation engine.

algorithmProfileVersion.description: Version string of the algorithm profile the engine applied.

evaluatorProfile.description: Evaluator profile (ID and version) the result was produced with.

precision.description: Numeric precision settings of the evaluator.

evaluatorPrecision.title: Evaluator precision
evaluatorPrecision.description: Numeric tolerances and limits an evaluator worked with. These are properties of the implementation, not product norms.

angularToleranceRad.description: Angular tolerance in rad, greater than 0.

curveApproximationToleranceMm.description: Maximum deviation in mm allowed when approximating curves (for example extension curve types written as line, arc or cubic segments).

solverTolerance.description: Convergence tolerance of the constraint solver (dimensionless, greater than 0).
